headline: Those who bet against Nvidia face a multimillion-dollar setback after Jensen Huang's return as CEO
summary: Nvidia short sellers faced paper losses of about $12.2 billion on Monday, their largest one-day loss since at least 2019, according to ORTEX. The losses followed Jensen Huang's return as CEO.
why: Short sellers borrow shares to bet on price declines, so sharp rallies create forced buying as they cover positions, which can amplify share price moves.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The rally that produced short-seller losses is driven by the reinstatement of Jensen Huang.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The rally after Jensen Huang's return as CEO pushed Nvidia's share price up, inflating losses for investors holding short positions.
original_headline: Los que apostaron contra Nvidia enfrentan millonario revés tras el regreso de Jensen Huang como CEO
